{{Top|leg}}
The '''Statue of Xim''' was a large metal and stone sculpture of the tyrant [[Xim/Legends|Xim]] the Despot on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Desevro/Legends|Desevro]]. It originally stood one hundred meters high and contained treasure chambers that had protective traps to fend off looters. During the end of Xim's reign, it was toppled by a [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquake]]. Nevertheless, it was included in the list of the [[Twenty Wonders of the Galaxy]] by the historian [[Vicendi]] in his [[10,000 BBY]] publication ''[[Arturum Galactinum]]''.<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
